title: pulicaria paludosa subsp. inuloides
intro: Pulicaria paludosa subsp. inuloides, commonly known as Marsh Fleabane, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Pulicaria paludosa subsp. inuloides include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of skin conditions like eczema and acne due to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its therapeutic actions, providing potential applications in the development of new medicines and treatments.
